verdict.rationale: Trello's own site lists an "MCP server" that lets you "Connect Trello to any AI tool" (trello-docs-6). That is a first-party claim of exactly this capability, but it is a single marketing line with no setup or technical documentation behind it in the pack. Missing for 10: MCP setup/connection docs, endpoint or transport details, list of exposed tools/actions, auth model for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect and operate Trello through it.
